This document outlines the equipment inspection 
I1 , which must be performed for condensate pump every six months as 
indicated by M6 in above title block .
This pump supply hydraulic oil for steam valves.

initiated by Eng. Mahmoud Abou El-Fotouh Shata, tested by eng. Ali Abd El-Salam

of Talkha Power Station .

This document accepted by Eng. Samer Abd El-Gilil 
MDEPC inspection & quality control general director MPIS coordinator & certified 
by accountant Mohamed Nageb MDEPC admin . & financial prediction head sector & 
supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector
